messages.content:
Risk: Exposure to toxic content
Description: AI exposing users to harmful, abusive, unsafe or inappropriate content. May involve AI creating, describing, providing advice, or encouraging action. Examples of toxic content include hate-speech, violence, extremism, illegal acts, child sexual abuse material, as well as content that violates community norms such as profanity, inflammatory political speech, or pornography.
Concern: None
Policy: Violence

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/GoalsAndObjectives/Objectives/Aim: aim — intention specifying a desired direction, condition, or situation toward which an agent's actions are directed, without requiring precise scope or measurable criteria [found by 8/14 queries]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Law/LegalCore/Law: law — rule recognized by some community as regulating the behavior of its members and that it may enforce through the imposition of penalties [found by 7/14 queries]
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 10/14 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Reference: reference — source that may be used to ascertain, interpret, or understand something [found by 10/14 queries]
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000971: Act of Deceptive Communication — Ac Act of Communication intended to mislead the audience by distortion or falsification of evidence and induce a reaction that is prejudicial to the interests of the audience. [found by 9/14 queries]
  Siblings: Act of Commissive Communication, Act of Representative Communication, Act of Directive Communication

axes.rationale: The risk involves AI creating, describing, or encouraging action related to harmful content, which can be seen as a form of deceptive communication intended to mislead users.
The risk involves content that may violate laws, such as illegal acts or child sexual abuse material, making 'law' a relevant instrument in assessing and mitigating the risk.
